scope_note: This workflow archives official injury reports and fetches/settles finals for the sealed v1 window. It does not refresh the published v2 team's schedule, standings, ratings, or player inputs, and it does not provide market prices. A successful run is not a v2 line-freshness or bet-eligibility approval.
note: One or more refresh/validation steps failed before status publication (finals_fetch). See the linked run for details; the exact source/API cause is not inferred.
